_note: PLACEHOLDER / output template for CardInfo. Shows every field and its allowed values. 'X | Y' means pick one; '... | null' means null when not visible/applicable/unsure. The binding contract is ../schema/card_info.schema.json — this file is for humans and for the extraction prompt. Remove '_note' in real records.
sport: baseball | basketball | football | hockey | soccer | other | null
year: string e.g. '2003' or '2003-04' | null  (hint: bottom of card front; graded label)
brand: string e.g. 'Topps', 'Panini', 'Upper Deck' | null  (hint: bottom of card front; graded label)
set: string | null  (hint: bottom of card front; graded label)
subset: string | null  (hint: bottom of card front; graded label)
card_number: string — the card's number WITHIN the set, e.g. '#250' | null (NOT the 5/30 serial)

attributes.serial_number: string — this copy's number in '07/99' -> '07' | null
attributes.serial_limit: string — total print run in '07/99' -> '99' | null
attributes.serial_matches_jersey_number: true | false | null — true when serial number equals the player's jersey number (rarer)

jersey_colors: array of color names visible on the jersey in the player's PICTURE, or null
jersey_number_candidates: if unsure, all plausible numbers best-first, e.g. '8', '3' — else null

pieces.type: patch | jersey | ball | floor | shoe | other | null
pieces.is_fabric: true if an actual piece of fabric/material, false if printed facsimile, null if unclear
colors: array of distinct colors in the piece, or null
pieces.letters_visible: string of any letters readable in the piece, e.g. 'AME' | null

graded._when: present when card_type = 'graded'; null for raw cards
graded.grading_company: PSA | BGS | SGC | CGC | TAG | other | null  (BGS = Beckett)
graded.grade_label: string as printed, e.g. 'GEM MINT 9.5' | null
graded.description: the descriptive info line(s) from the label | null
graded.autograph_grade: number 0-10 — separate AUTOGRAPH grade some labels print (e.g. 'BECKETT 10 AUTOGRAPH') | null
graded.label_text: full raw OCR of the label | null

raw_output: object with raw OCR/model output for debugging | null
